scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "node scripts/dev-api.cjs" "npm run dev -w @wms/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,mobile -c cyan,magenta,green "node scripts/dev-api.cjs" "npm run dev -w @wms/web" "npm run start -w @wms/mobile"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev:all
